### Electromed, Inc. to Participate in the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference and LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event


09/09/2026


NEW PRAGUE, Minn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Electromed, Inc. (“Electromed”) (NYSE American: ELMD), a leader in innovative airway clearance technologies, today announced their attendance at the HC Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference being held September 14-16, 2026, in New York. Jim Cunniff, Electromed’s President and Chief Executive Officer, will present at 3:30 ET on Monday, September 14, 2026. Management will also host one-on-one meetings with investors.


Electromed will also be attending the LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event being held October 19-21, 2026, in Los Angeles. Jim Cunniff will be presenting during the event, and the Company will be hosting one-on-one meetings with investors.


Links to the live webcast of each presentation will be available on Electromed’s website:[Events & Presentations | SmartVest](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.smartvest.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54601377&newsitemid=20260909201581&lan=en-US&anchor=Events+%26amp%3B+Presentations+%7C+SmartVest&index=1&md5=45d2884a6bd66b20622124cc15e65b42) .


**About Electromed, Inc.**


Electromed, Inc. manufactures, markets, and sells products that provide airway clearance therapy, including the SmartVest® Airway Clearance System, to patients with compromised pulmonary function. It is headquartered in New Prague, Minnesota, and was founded in 1992. Further information about Electromed can be found at[www.smartvest.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.smartvest.com&esheet=54601377&newsitemid=20260909201581&lan=en-US&anchor=www.smartvest.com&index=2&md5=55382397926bf3fce670c68ecf645ead) .
